title: Forgot password | Bobbin
bodyText: Check your email If atlas.research@example.com has a Bobbin account, we've sent it a link to set a new password. The link expires in 48 hours and can be used once. Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder. If you sign in through TutorCruncher, your password lives there rather than in Bobbin, so use the TutorCruncher login instead. Back to login
